specialRules.name: Starting Equipment
specialRules.description: Masterwork Heavy Armour, Bec de Corbin, Helmet. Further weapons, armour and equipment can be bought from the Reavers Equipment list.

specialRules.name: Survivor
specialRules.description:
Cannot be taken out of Action unless the model is already Knocked Down or Stunned. Treat Out of Action as Stunned if the Conqueror is standing when receiving the Wound.

In addition, the first time a Conqueror suffers a Dead result on the Serious Injury Chart, treat it as Multiple Injuries instead. This ability can save the Conqueror only one time.

specialRules.name: Starting Equipment
specialRules.description: Heavy Armour, Misericordia, 2 Swords, Helmet. Further weapons, armour and equipment can be bought from the Reavers Equipment list.

specialRules.name: Duellist
specialRules.description: If the Saurus Slayer is engaged with only a single opponent in melee, they can re-roll missed hits on the first turn whether they charged the enemy or were charged.

specialRules.name: Special Equipment Access
specialRules.description:
Saurus-Slayers may purchase the following special equipment:

- Lizardmen Skin Cloak: Grants 6+ Ward save, separate from Armour Save that is not reduced by enemy strength or other modifiers. (10 gc)
- Skull Mask: Causes Fear. (15 gc)
- Upgrade any sword into a Lizardman Sword: +1 to wound rolls due to Poison. (30 gc)
- Trophy Slann Holy Headdress: +2 bonus to armour saves. (35 gc)

specialRules.name: Starting Equipment
specialRules.description: Heavy Armour, Spear, Sword. Further weapons, armour and equipment can be bought from the Reavers Equipment list.

specialRules.name: War Beasts
specialRules.description: If your Warband includes a Beastmaster, you may include up to 2 War Beasts from the list below. These count towards the maximum size of the Warband. They must be bought when the Warband is created but can be replaced if killed. The War Beasts can use the Ld of the Beastmaster if they are within 6” of the Beastmaster.

specialRules.name: Starting Equipment
specialRules.description: Javelins, Light Armour, two Daggers. Further weapons, armour and equipment can be bought from the Reavers Equipment list.

specialRules.name: Wizard Upgrade
specialRules.description: At the cost of +30 Gold Crowns, you can make Jungle Shadow a Wizard. Jungle Shadow uses the Lesser Magic list. Generate a single Spell as standard for a wizard. If you make the Jungle Shadow a Wizard, remove the Light Armour from the equipment list when starting out, and generate 1 Lesser Magic spell they can use.

specialRules.name: Silent Hunter
specialRules.description: Jungle Shadow is always considered to be Hidden if the model is touching any piece of terrain of 1” high. Shooting does not reveal Jungle Shadow’s position, though spellcasting does.

specialRules.name: Surprise attack
specialRules.description: If the Shadow attacks an enemy that has its back turned to the Jungle Shadow (i.e. the shot is coming from 180 degree angle from behind its facing), the Shadow can re-roll missed to hit rolls.

specialRules.name: Canopy Walker
specialRules.description: Jungle Shadow automatically passes all climbing, jumping and falling off ledges tests.

specialRules.name: Starting Equipment
specialRules.description: Heavy Armour, Sword, Tilean Hunting Rifle (Treat as Hochland Long Rifle), Firepots, Leaf Coat (counts as an Elven Cloak). Further weapons, armour and equipment can be bought from the Reavers Equipment list.

specialRules.name: Deadeye
specialRules.description: Trapmaster suffers no penalties for shooting at long range.

specialRules.name: Traps
specialRules.description: The Trapmaster starts each game with 1 Trap and can buy up to 5 further of the following Traps before the start of the game at the cost of 5 GC each. Each trap is one use only. Traps are used in the Shooting Phase instead of shooting, 1 trap at a time, and cannot be used in Melee combat. When you use a trap, put 2 1” diameter Trap counters (one false, one real) anywhere within 3” of the Trapmaster, but at least 3” away from any other models. Any model that moves within 2” of the counter must flip it over. If it is a false one, nothing happens. If it is a real one, the model suffers D3 S5 Hits immediately. Traps do not cause Criticals. Remove the counters when the trap is sprung.

specialRules.name: Promotion Only
specialRules.description: Re-roll any Lad’s Got Talent results on Henchmen Advancement table. When promoted, you can then hire a new Prospect as the model no longer counts as one of them.

specialRules.name: 5+ armour save
specialRules.description: Beastmasters raise savage Estalian warhounds: giant beasts trained to bring down any prey or enemy, and protected by padded armour to ward off arrows and iron collars against blades.

specialRules.name: Animal
specialRules.description: All the War Beasts are subject to the rules of Animals and may not gain experience. They suffer injuries exactly as Henchmen (if taken out of action they are dead on a roll of 1-2 on D6).

specialRules.name: Nimble
specialRules.description: Can climb any sheer surfaces without taking Initiative tests. Can re-roll all failed Diving Charge tests. The Monkey can enter buildings unlike other animals. Due to its agility, the Monkey also has a 5+ Ward save which it can take against any and all wounds it suffers in Melee combat or from shooting/magic or even falling damage.

specialRules.name: Animal
specialRules.description: All the War Beasts are subject to the rules of Animals and may not gain experience. They suffer injuries exactly as Henchmen (if taken out of action they are dead on a roll of 1-2 on D6).

specialRules.name: Part of the Equipment
specialRules.description: Acts at the same time as the Beastmaster. Can attack any enemy within 12” as a melee attack, even those out of line of sight (unless Hidden), and return to the Beastmaster immediately. The hawk cannot be targeted separately by any attack or spell. The Hawk does not attack if the Beastmaster is engaged in hand-to-hand combat, being too busy to command the hawk!

specialRules.name: Animal
specialRules.description: All the War Beasts are subject to the rules of Animals and may not gain experience. They suffer injuries exactly as Henchmen (if taken out of action they are dead on a roll of 1-2 on D6).

exclusiveEquipment.name: Misericordia
exclusiveEquipment.rulesText:
Daggers are not the best weapons to use for penetrating an enemy model's armour. An enemy wounded by a dagger gains a +1 bonus to his armour save, and a 6+ armour save if he has none normally.

When attacking enemies that are Knocked-Down you get to roll 2D6 and pick the highest number on ‘to wound’ roll.

exclusiveEquipment.name: Javelins
exclusiveEquipment.rulesText: Javelins are thrown weapons and the warrior suffers no penalty for range or moving.

exclusiveEquipment.name: Blowpipe
exclusiveEquipment.rulesText:
The needles fired by a blowpipe are coated in a venom very similar in its effects to the Black Lotus (if you roll a 6 on the To Hit roll, the victim is automatically wounded). A blowpipe cannot cause critical hits. This weapon has a positive armour save modifier, so a model that normally has a save of 5+ will get a save of 4+ against a blowpipe dart. Even models that normally do not have an armour save will get a 6+ save to take into account protection offered by clothes, fur or the like.

A model armed with a blowpipe can fire while hidden without revealing his position to the enemy. The target model can take an Initiative test in order to try to spot the firing model. If the test is successful, the model no longer counts as hidden.

exclusiveEquipment.name: Warhound
exclusiveEquipment.rulesText:
If you purchase a wardog, it will fight exactly like a member of your warband, though it is treated as part of the equipment of the Hero who bought it. You will need a model to represent it on a battlefield.

Wardogs never gain experience, and if they are put out of action they have exactly the same chance of recovering as Henchmen (ie, 1-2: Dead; 3-6: Alive).

Wardogs count towards the maximum number of warriors allowed in your warband.❓
